name: Thakkers Developers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Thakkers Developers Ltd  is in the business of Real Estate & Construction activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TDL is a part of Thakkers Group. It is a construction and real estate enterprise in Nashik constructing residential, commercial, plots, retail, agricultural segment, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.90 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.62% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.05% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.76 Cr.
